verses.geez: መጽሐፍ፡ ነገሩ፡ ለጦብያ፡ ወልደ፡ ጦቢት፡ ወልደ፡ ገባኤል፡ ዘእምነ፡ አሳሔል፡ ዘእምነገደ፡ ንፍታሌም።
verses.translation: The book of the words of Tobit, the son of Tobiel, the son of Ananiel, the son of Aduel, the son of Gabael, of the seed of Asael, of the tribe of Nephthali;

translations.lxx: The book of the words of Tobit, the son of Tobiel, the son of Ananiel, the son of Aduel, the son of Gabael, of the seed of Asael, of the tribe of Nephthali;
translations.ron: Cartea istoriei lui Tobit, fiul lui Tobiel, al lui Ananiel, al lui Aduel, al lui Gabael, din neamul lui Asiel, din seminţia lui Neftali,
translations.grk: ΒΙΒΛΟΣ λόγων Τωβὶτ, τοῦ Τωβιὴλ, τοῦ Ανανιὴλ, τοῦ Ἀδουὴλ, τοῦ Γαβαήλ, ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος Ἀσιήλ, ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Νεφθαλί,

verses.geez: ዘተፄወወ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ አኔሜሴር፡ ንጉሠ፡ ፋርስ፡ ዘእምታቢስ፡ እንተ፡ እምየማና፡ ለቃዴስ፡ ዘእንተ፡ ንፍታሌም፡ ዘገሊላ፡ እንተ፡ መልዕልተ፡ አሴር።
verses.translation: who in the time of Enemessar king of the Assyrians was led captive out of Thisbe, which is at the right hand of that city, which is called properly Nephthali in Galilee above Aser.

translations.lxx: who in the time of Enemessar king of the Assyrians was led captive out of Thisbe, which is at the right hand of that city, which is called properly Nephthali in Galilee above Aser.
translations.ron: Care, în zilele lui Salmanasar, regele Asiriei, a fost luat în robie din Tisbe, care se află la miazăzi de Cadeş Neftali, în Galileea de sus, mai sus de Haţor, retras spre apus, şi la miazănoapte de Şefat.
translations.grk: ὃς ᾐχμαλωτεύθη ἐν ἡμέραις Ἐνεμεσσάρου τοῦ βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων ἐκ Θίσβης, ἥ ἐστιν ἐκ δεξιῶν κυδίως τῆς Νεφθαλὶ ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ ὑπεράνω Ἀσήρ.

verses.geez: አነ፡ ጦቢት፡ በፍኖተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ሖርኩ፡ ወበርትዕ፡ ሐየውኩ፡ በኵሉ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሕይወትየ፡ ወምጽዋትየኒ፡ ብዙኃ፡ ገበርኩ፡ ለአኃውየ፡ ወለሕዝብየኒ፡ እለ፡ ሖሩ፡ ምስሌየ፡ ብሔረ፡ ፋርስ፡ ውስተ፡ ነነዌ።
verses.translation: I Tobit have walked all the days of my life in the way of truth and justice, and I did many alms-deeds to my brethren, and my nation, who came with me to Nineve, into the land of the Assyrians.

translations.lxx: I Tobit have walked all the days of my life in the way of truth and justice, and I did many alms-deeds to my brethren, and my nation, who came with me to Nineve, into the land of the Assyrians.
translations.ron: Eu, Tobit, în toate zilele vieţii mele am umblat pe căile adevărului şi ale dreptăţii şi am făcut multe binefaceri fraţilor mei şi poporului meu, care venise împreună cu mine la Ninive, în ţara Asiriei.
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ Τωβὶτ ὁδοῖς ἀληθείας ἐπορευόμην καὶ δικαιοσύνης πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς μου· καὶ ἐλεημοσύνας πολλὰς ἐποίησα τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μον, καὶ τῷ ἔθνει, τοῖς προπορευθεῖσι μετʼ ἐμοῦ εἰς χώραν Ἀσσυρίων εἰς Νινευή.

verses.geez: ወእንዘ፡ ሀሎኩ፡ ምስለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ በብሔርየ፡ እንዘ፡ ንዑስ፡ አነ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ሕዝበ፡ ንፍታሌም፡ ወአቡየ፡ ክህዱ፡ እምነ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ እንተ፡ ኃረይዋ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ እስራኤል፡ ከመ፡ ይሡዑ፡ ውስቴታ፡ ኵሉ፡ እስራኤል፡ ወተቀደሰ፡ ጽርሐ፡ መቅደሱ፡ ለልዑል፡ ወተሐንፀ፡ ሎሙ፡ ለትውልድ፡ ዘለዓለም።
verses.translation: And when I was in mine own country, in the land of Israel, being but young, all the tribe of Nephthali my father fell from the house of Jerusalem, which was chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, that all the tribes should sacrifice there, and, where the temple of the habitation of the most High was consecrated and built for all ages.

translations.lxx: And when I was in mine own country, in the land of Israel, being but young, all the tribe of Nephthali my father fell from the house of Jerusalem, which was chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, that all the tribes should sacrifice there, and, where the temple of the habitation of the most High was consecrated and built for all ages.
translations.ron: Când trăiam eu în ţara mea, în pământul lui Israel, fiind încă tânăr, toată seminţia lui Neftali, străbunul meu, s-a despărţit de casa lui David şi de Ierusalim. Acesta fusese ales dintre toate triburile lui Israel pentru jertfele lor; acolo fusese zidit templul în care locuieşte Cel Preaînalt şi Sfinţit pentru toate neamurile viitoare.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὅτι ἤμην ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ μου ἐν τῇ γῇ Ἰσραὴλ, νεωτέρου μου ὄντος, πᾶσα φυλὴ τοῦ Νεφθαλὶ τοῦ πατρός μου ἀπέστη ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴκου Ἰεροσολύμων, τῆς ἐκλεγείσης ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν φυλῶν Ἰσραὴλ, εἰς τὸ θυσιάζειν πάσας τὰς φυλάς· καὶ ἡγιάσθη ὁ ναὸς τῆς κατασκηνώσεως τοῦ ὑψίστου, καὶ ᾠκοδομήθη εἰς πάσας τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος.

verses.geez: ወኵሉ፡ ሕዝብ፡ እለ፡ ክህዱ፡ ሦዑ፡ ለበዓል፡ ወለደማሊ፡ ወቤተ፡ ንፍታሌምኒ፡ ወቤተ፡ አቡየ፡ ኀብሩ፡ ምስሌሆሙ።
verses.translation: Now all the tribes which together revolted, and the house of my father Nephthali, sacrificed unto the heifer Baal.

translations.lxx: Now all the tribes which together revolted, and the house of my father Nephthali, sacrificed unto the heifer Baal.
translations.ron: Toţi fraţii mei şi casa lui Neftali jertfeau viţelului lui Baal pe care-l făcuse Ieroboam, regele lui Israel, la Dan, pe munţii Galileii.
translations.grk: Καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ αἱ συναποστᾶσαι ἔθυον τῇ Βάαλ τῇ δαμάλει, καὶ ὁ οἶκος Νεφθαλὶ τοῦ πατρός μου.

verses.geez: ወአነ፡ ባሕቲትየ፡ መብዝኅቶ፡ አሐውር፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ አመ፡ በዓላት፡ በከመ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ለኵሉ፡ እስራኤል፡ ውስተ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ ዘለዓለም፡ እምነ፡ ቀዳሚት፡ ዘቀረጽኩ፡ እወስድ፡ ሎሙ፡ ለካህናት፡ ለደቂቀ፡ አሮን፡ ኀበ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ኵሎ፡ እክለ።
verses.translation: But I alone went often to Jerusalem at the feasts, as it was ordained unto all the people of Israel by an everlasting decree, having the first-fruits and tenths of increase, with that which was first shorn; and them gave I at the altar to the priests the children of Aaron.

translations.lxx: But I alone went often to Jerusalem at the feasts, as it was ordained unto all the people of Israel by an everlasting decree, having the first-fruits and tenths of increase, with that which was first shorn; and them gave I at the altar to the priests the children of Aaron.
translations.ron: Mă duceam adesea singur la Ierusalim, de sărbători, ca să împlinesc legea ce îndatorează pe tot Israelul pentru totdeauna. Mă duceam la Ierusalim cu pârgă din roade şi din animale, cu dijmă din vite şi cu prima tunsoare a oilor.
translations.grk: Κᾀγὼ μόνος ἐπορευόμην πλεονάκις εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἐν ταῖς ἑορταῖς, καθὼς γέγραπται παντὶ τῷ Ἰσραὴλ, ἐν προστάγματι αἰωνίῳ, τὰς ἀπαρχὰς, καὶ τὰς δεκάτας τῶν γεννημάτων, καὶ τὰς πρωτοκουρίας ἔχων, καὶ ἐδίδουν αὐτὰς τοῖς ἱερεῦσι τοῖς υἱοῖς ʼΑαρὼν πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον πάντων τῶν γεννημάτων.

verses.geez: ወቀዳሜ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዓሥራት፡ እሁቦሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ አሮን፡ እለ፡ ይፀመዱ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ ወዘዳግመ፡ ዓሥራተ፡ እዔሥር፡ ወአስተዋጽእ፡ ምጽዋተ፡ ወአሐውር፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ በበዓመት።
verses.translation: The first tenth part of all increase I gave to the sons of Aaron, who ministered at Jerusalem: another tenth part I sold away, and went, and spent it every year at Jerusalem:

translations.lxx: The first tenth part of all increase I gave to the sons of Aaron, who ministered at Jerusalem: another tenth part I sold away, and went, and spent it every year at Jerusalem:
translations.ron: Şi le dam preoţilor, fiii lui Aaron, pentru jertfelnic, iar o zeciuială din vin şi grâu, din măsline, din rodie şi din celelalte roade ale pământului o dădeam fiilor lui Levi care slujeau în Ierusalim; a doua zeciuială o vindeam şi în fiecare an mă duceam şi o cheltuiam la Ierusalim;
translations.grk: Τὴν δεκάτην ἐδίδουν τοῖς υἱοῖς Λευὶ τοῖς θεραπεύουσιν εἰς Ἱερουσαλήμ, καὶ τὴν δευτέραν δεκάτην ἀπεπρατιζόμην, καὶ ἐπορευόμην καὶ ἐδαπάνων· αὐτὰ ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις καθʼ ἕκαστον ἐνιαυτὸν,

verses.geez: ወሣልስተ፡ እሁብ፡ ለነዳያን፡ በከመ፡ አዘዘት፡ ዲቦራ፡ እሙ፡ ለአቡየ፡ እስመ፡ ዕጓለ፡ ማውታ፡ ኀደጉኒ፡ አቡየ፡ ወእምየ።
verses.translation: and the third I gave unto them to whom it was meet, as Debora my father's mother had commanded me, because I was left an orphan by my father.

translations.lxx: and the third I gave unto them to whom it was meet, as Debora my father's mother had commanded me, because I was left an orphan by my father.
translations.ron: Iar o a treia o dădeam orfanilor, văduvelor şi străinilor care locuiesc cu Israeliţii; le-o aduceam ca dar din trei în trei ani. Noi o mâncam, credincioşi în acelaşi timp sfaturilor Deborei, mama tatălui meu, Ananiel, căci eu, după moartea tatălui meu, am rămas orfan.
translations.grk: καὶ τὴν τρίτην ἐδίδουν οἷς καθήκει, καθὼς ἐνετείλατο Δεββωρὰ ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ πατρός μου, διότι ὀρφανὸς κατελείφθην ὑπὸ τοῦ πατρός μου.

verses.geez: ወአመ፡ ኮንኩ፡ ብእሴ፡ ነሣእኩ፡ ሊተ፡ ብእሲተ፡ እምነ፡ አዝማድየ፡ ወወለድኩ፡ እምኔሃ፡ ጦብያሃ።
verses.translation: Furthermore, when I was come to the age of a man, I married Anna of mine own kindred, and of her I begat Tobias.

translations.lxx: Furthermore, when I was come to the age of a man, I married Anna of mine own kindred, and of her I begat Tobias.
translations.ron: Ajungând în vârstă bărbătească, mi-am luat de femeie pe Ana, din neamul nostru şi ea mi-a născut pe Tobie.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὅτε ἐγενόμην ἀνήρ, ἔλαβον Ἄνναν γυναῖκα ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος τῆς πατριᾶς ἡμῶν· καὶ ἐγέννησα ἐξ αὐτῆς Τωβίαν.

verses.geez: ወአመ፡ ተፄወዉ፡ ነነዌ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ አኃውየ፡ ወአዝማድየ፡ በልዑ፡ እምነ፡ እክለ፡ አሕዛብ።
verses.translation: And when we were carried away captives to Nineve, all my brethren and those that were of my kindred did eat of the bread of the Gentiles.

translations.lxx: And when we were carried away captives to Nineve, all my brethren and those that were of my kindred did eat of the bread of the Gentiles.
translations.ron: Şi când am fost dus în robie la Ninive, toţi fraţii mei şi toţi cei de un neam cu mine au mâncat din mâncărurile acelora.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὅτε ᾐχμαλωτίσθημεν εἰς Νινευῆ, πάντες οἱ ἀδελφοί μου, καὶ οἱ ἐκ τοῦ γένους μου ἤσθιον ἐκ τῶν ἄρτων τῶν ἐθνῶν·

verses.geez: ወአንሰ፡ ዓቀብኩ፡ ነፍስየ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይብላዕ።
verses.translation: But I kept myself from eating;

translations.lxx: But I kept myself from eating;
translations.ron: Iar eu mi-am păzit sufletul şi n-am mâncat,
translations.grk: ἐγὼ δὲ συνετήρησα τὴν ψυχήν μου μὴ φαγεῖν,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እዜክሮ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ በኵሉ፡ ልብየ።
verses.translation: because I remembered God with all my heart.

translations.lxx: because I remembered God with all my heart.
translations.ron: Căci mi-am adus aminte de Dumnezeu cu toată inima mea.
translations.grk: καθότι ἐμεμνήμην τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ ψυχῇ μου.

verses.geez: ወወሀበኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ገጸ፡ ወሞገሰ፡ በቅድመ፡ አኔሜሴር፡ ወሤመኒ፡ መጋቢሁ።
verses.translation: And the most High gave me grace and favour before Enemessar, so that I was his purveyor.

translations.lxx: And the most High gave me grace and favour before Enemessar, so that I was his purveyor.
translations.ron: Şi mi-a dăruit Cel Preaînalt milă şi bunăvoinţă înaintea lui Salmanasar şi am fost omul lui de încredere.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδωκεν ὁ ὕψιστος χάριν καὶ μορφὴν ἐνώπιον Ἐνεμεσσάρου, καὶ ἤμην αὐτοῦ ἀγοραστής.

verses.geez: ወሖርኩ፡ ምድያም፡ ወአዕቀብክዎ፡ ለገባኤል፡ በብሔረ፡ ራጊስ፡ ዘምድያም፡ ዐሠርተ፡ መካልየ፡ ብሩር።
verses.translation: And I went into Media, and left in trust with Gabael, the brother of Gabrias, at Rages a city of Media, ten talents of silver.

translations.lxx: And I went into Media, and left in trust with Gabael, the brother of Gabrias, at Rages a city of Media, ten talents of silver.
translations.ron: M-am dus în Media şi am dat lui Gabael, fratele lui Gabri, din Ragheşul Mediei, zece talanţi de argint să-i păstreze.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπορευόμην εἰς τὴν Μηδίαν, καὶ παρεθέμην Γαβαήλῳ τῷ ἀδελφῷ Γαβρία ἐν Ῥάγοις τῆς Μηδίας, ἀργυρίου τάλαντα δέκα.

verses.geez: ወአመ፡ ሞተ፡ አኔሜሴር፡ ነግሠ፡ ህየንቴሁ፡ ሰናክሬም፡ ዘእኩይ፡ ምግባሩ፡ ወሠዐረኒ፡ ወኢክህልኩ፡ ሐዊረ፡ ምድያም።
verses.translation: Now when Enemessar was dead, Sennacherib his son reigned in his stead; whose estate was troubled, that I could not go into Media.

translations.lxx: Now when Enemessar was dead, Sennacherib his son reigned in his stead; whose estate was troubled, that I could not go into Media.
translations.ron: Iar dacă a murit Salmanasar, s-a făcut rege în locul lui fiul său, Sanherib; căile Mediei s-au închis, şi eu nu m-am mai putut duce în Media.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὅτε ἀπέθανεν Ἐνεμεσσὰρ, ἐβασίλευσε Σενναχηρὶμ ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ, καὶ αἱ ὁδοὶ αὐτοῦ ἠκαταστάθησαν, καὶ οὐκ ἔτι ἠδυνάσθην πορευθῆναι εἰς τὴν Μηδίαν.

verses.geez: ወበመዋዕ፡ አኔሜሴር፡ ብዙኃ፡ ምጽዋተ፡ ገበርኩ፡ ለአኃውየ።
verses.translation: And in the time of Enemessar I gave many alms to my brethren, and gave my bread to the hungry,

translations.lxx: And in the time of Enemessar I gave many alms to my brethren, and gave my bread to the hungry,
translations.ron: În zilele lui Salmanasar am făcut multe binefaceri fraţilor mei de neam:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἐνεμεσσάρου ἐλεημοσύνας πολλὰς ἐποίουν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μου·

verses.geez: ወእክልየኒ፡ ወሀብኩ፡ ለርኁባን፡ ወልብስየኒ፡ ለዕሩቃን፡ ወእመቦ፡ ዘርኢኩ፡ እምሕዝብየ፡ ምውተ፡ ግዱፈ፡ ኀበ፡ ዓረፍት፡ በነነዌ፡ እቀብሮ።
verses.translation: and my clothes to the naked: and if I saw any of my nation dead, or cast about the walls of Nineve, I buried him.

translations.lxx: and my clothes to the naked: and if I saw any of my nation dead, or cast about the walls of Nineve, I buried him.
translations.ron: Celor flămânzi le dădeam pâinea mea, celor goi, hainele mele, şi de vedeam pe careva din neamul meu mort şi aruncat peste zidurile Ninivei, îl îngropam.
translations.grk: τοὺς ἄρτους μου ἐδίδουν τοῖς πεινῶσι, καὶ ἱμάτια τοῖς γυμνοῖς· καὶ εἴ τινα ἐκ τοῦ γένους μου ἐθεώρουν τεθνηκότα καὶ ἐῤῥιμμένον ὀπίσω τοῦ τείχους Νινευή, ἔθαπτον αὐτόν.

verses.geez: እመቦ፡ ዘቀተለ፡ ሰናክሬም፡ ንጉሠ፡ አመ፡ አተወ፡ እምይሁዳ፡ እንዘ፡ ይጐይይ፡ ወአነ፡ ቀበርክዎሙ፡ ጽሚተ፡ እስመ፡ ብዙኃነ፡ ቀተለ፡ በመዓቱ፡ ወኃሠሠ፡ ንጉሥ፡ አብድንቲሆሙ፡ ወኢረከቦሙ።
verses.translation: And if the king Sennacherib had slain any, when he was come, and fled from Judea, I buried them privily; for in his wrath he killed many; but the bodies were not found, when they were sought for of the king.

translations.lxx: And if the king Sennacherib had slain any, when he was come, and fled from Judea, I buried them privily; for in his wrath he killed many; but the bodies were not found, when they were sought for of the king.
translations.ron: Ba am îngropat pe ascuns şi pe aceia pe care i-a ucis regele Sanherib, când se întorceau fugari din Iudeea. Sanherib a ucis mulţi Israeliţi în mânia sa. Şi a căutat regele trupurile şi nu le-a găsit.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἴ τινα ἀπέκτεννε Σενναχηρὶμ ὁ βασιλεὺς, ὅτε ἦλθε φεύγων ἐκ τῆς Ἰιυδαίας, ἔθαψα αὐτοὺς κλέπτων· πολλοὺς γὰρ ἀπέκτεινεν ἐν τῷ θυμῷ αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἐζητήθη ὑπὸ τοῦ βασιλέως τὰ σώματα, καὶ οὐχ εὑρέθη.

verses.geez: ወሖረ፡ አሐዱ፡ እምሰብአ፡ ነነዌ፡ ኀበ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ወአስተዋደየኒ፡ ከመ፡ አነ፡ ቀበርክዎሙ፡ ወተኀባዕኩ፡ ሶበ፡ አእመርኩ፡ ከመ፡ ይፈቅዱ፡ ይቅትሉኒ፡ ወፈሪህየ፡ ተግኅሥኩ።
verses.translation: And when one of the Ninevites went and complained of me to the king, that I buried them, and hid myself; understanding that I was sought for to be put to death, I withdrew myself for fear.

translations.lxx: And when one of the Ninevites went and complained of me to the king, that I buried them, and hid myself; understanding that I was sought for to be put to death, I withdrew myself for fear.
translations.ron: Şi s-a dus unul dintre niniviteni şi m-a pârât la rege, că eu i-am îngropat, şi atunci eu m-am ascuns. Aflând însă că mă caută să mă ucidă, de frică am fugit din cetate.
translations.grk: Πορευθεὶς δὲ εἷς τῶν ἐν Νινευῇ, ὑπέδειξε τῷ βασιλεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ ὅτι θάπτω αὐτοὺς, και ἐκρύβην· ἐπιγνοὺς δὲ ὅτι ζητοῦμαι ἀποθανεῖν, φοβηθεὶς ἀνεχώρησα.

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ ኃጥኡኒ፡ በርበሩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ንዋይየ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘአትረፉ፡ ሊተ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ሐና፡ ብእሲትየ፡ ወጦብያ፡ ወልድየ።
verses.translation: Then all my goods were forcibly taken away, neither was there any thing left me, beside my wife Anna and my son Tobias.

translations.lxx: Then all my goods were forcibly taken away, neither was there any thing left me, beside my wife Anna and my son Tobias.
translations.ron: Şi mi s-a jefuit atunci toată averea mea şi nu mi-a rămas nimic, decât numai Ana, femeia mea, şi fiul meu, Tobie.
translations.grk: Καὶ διηρπάγη πάντα τὰ ὑπάρχοντά μου, καὶ οὐ κατελείφθη μοι οὐδὲν, πλὴν Ἄννας τῆς γυναικός μου, καὶ Τωβὶου τοῦ υἱοῦ μου.

verses.geez: ወኢወፃእኩ፡ ሃምሳ፡ ወሐምስተ፡ መዋዕለ፡ እስከ፡ አመ፡ ቀተልዎ፡ ክልኤሆሙ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ወጐዩ፡ ውስተ፡ አራራት፡ ወነግሠ፡ አስራዶን፡ ወልዱ፡ ህየንቴሁ፡ ወሤሞ፡ ለአካኪሮን፡ ወልደ፡ አሳሔል፡ ወልደ፡ እኁየ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ቤተ፡ አቡሁ፡ ወላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥርዓቶሙ።
verses.translation: And there passed not fifty days, before two of his sons killed him, and they fled into the mountains of Ararath; and Sarchedonus his son reigned in his stead; who appointed over his father's accounts, and over all his affairs, Achiacharus my brother Anael's son.

translations.lxx: And there passed not fifty days, before two of his sons killed him, and they fled into the mountains of Ararath; and Sarchedonus his son reigned in his stead; who appointed over his father's accounts, and over all his affairs, Achiacharus my brother Anael's son.
translations.ron: Dar n-au trecut patruzeci de zile, şi regele a fost ucis de cei doi fii ai săi care au fugit în munţii Araratului. În locul lui s-a făcut rege Asarhadon, fiul său, care a pus pe Ahiacar, fiul fratelui meu, Anael, peste toate veniturile regatului său şi peste toată Cârmuirea casei lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐ διῆλθον ἡμέρας πεντήκοντα, ἕως οὗ ἀπέκτειναν αὐτὸν οἱ δύο υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἔφυγον εἰς τὰ ὄρη Ἀραράθ· καὶ ἐβασίλευσε Σαχερδονὸς υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔταξεν Ἀχιάχαρον τὸν Ἀναὴλ υἱὸν τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ μου ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν ἐκλογιστίαν τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν διοίκησιν.

verses.geez: ወሰአሎ፡ በእንቲአየ፡ አካኪሮን፡ ወአዕተወኒ፡ ውስተ፡ ነነዌ፡ ወአካኪሮን፡ ዘላዕሌሁ፡ ማኅተም፡ ወፃዕፃዕ፡ ቤቱ፡ ወሤመ፡ ዳግመ፡ አክሮንድስሃ።
verses.translation: And Achiacharus intreating for me, I returned to Nineve. Now Achiacharus was cupbearer, and keeper of the signet, and steward, and overseer of the accounts: and Sarchedonus appointed him next unto him: and he was my brother's son.

translations.lxx: And Achiacharus intreating for me, I returned to Nineve. Now Achiacharus was cupbearer, and keeper of the signet, and steward, and overseer of the accounts: and Sarchedonus appointed him next unto him: and he was my brother's son.
translations.ron: Şi a mijlocit Ahiacar pentru mine şi m-am întors la Ninive. Ahiacar însă era şi paharnic şi păstrătorul sigiliului, cârmuitor al casei şi vistiernic. Şi Asarhadon l-a pus al doilea după el, şi el era fiul fratelui meu.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἠξίωσεν Ἀχιάχαρος περὶ ἐμοῦ, καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Νινευή. Ἀχιάχαρος δὲ ἦν ὁ οἰνοχόος, καὶ ἐπὶ τοῦ δακτυλίου, καὶ διοικητὴς, καὶ ἐκλογιστὴς, καὶ κατέστησεν αὐτὸν ὁ Σαχερδονὸς· ἐκ δευτέρας, ἦν δὲ ἐξάδελφός μου.

note: Tobit in the Assyrian exile. A story of faithfulness in diaspora, angelic intervention (Raphael), demonic threat (Asmodeus), and the healing power of fish organs. Beloved in Ethiopian tradition for its emphasis on almsgiving and family loyalty.
